acceptance_criteria: SpeedBridge CI fails when client startup is not confirmed.
Agents can explicitly change lifecycle state and completed one-shot agents do not remain ambiguously available.
Agent state changes are validated and covered by tests.
Documentation recommends references or Actions artifacts instead of committing large Base64 source archives.
All existing and new workspace tests pass.
objective: Fix the SpeedBridge CI false-positive startup gate, add explicit agent lifecycle state management, and document artifact storage practices without changing the completed agent's task artifacts.
title: Harden agent workspace after first production run
